title: Wick's Sister
summary: A girl from the pillager camps has walked three days to find you. Wick was her brother. She doesn't want revenge. She wants to know why.

quest_book.title: A Letter in Bad Handwriting
quest_book.author: Nell
pages:
You hanged my brother.

I'm not coming to hurt you. I couldn't if I wanted to.

I just want to look at the person who decided he wasn't worth a second chance. I'll be in a village to the west.

- Nell

threats.name: Nell
threats.target_line: So you're the one. You're shorter than I thought.
talk: Nell. He was the only one who ever came back for me.
He sold us to the raiders.
He sold you patrol times. For bread. I ate that bread.
Nothing you can give. I just wanted to see your face. Now I have.
